jobs.name: ETH term inversion monitor - paper trade proposals
jobs.prompt:
Run the ETH term structure inversion paper trade monitor against the composite regime signal pipeline. The monitor reads the latest entry from composite_signal_log.jsonl, checks if both triggers 'term_inversion' AND 'severe_liq' are active, and if so generates a structured paper trade proposal for ETH SHORT. Use --current-only --write flags to only evaluate the latest signal and persist any new proposals. The script is at:
/home/frank/.hermes/kanban/boards/sycode-trading/workspaces/t_6fe34aa7/eth_term_inversion_monitor.py

Run it with: cd /home/frank/.hermes/kanban/boards/sycode-trading/workspaces/t_6fe34aa7 && python3 eth_term_inversion_monitor.py --current-only --write

Report: number of signal entries scanned, new proposals generated, and current market context (regime, term inversion, liq ratio, DVOL). Also report whether trigger conditions are currently met. If no new proposals, report as such.
